name: potentially-processed
description: Is it ultra-processed? A static NOVA lookup site built from Open Food Facts data.

scripts.data: npm run data:taxonomies && npm run data:extract -- --input https://static.openfoodfacts.org/data/openfoodfacts-products.jsonl.gz --min-lines 1000000 && npm run data:select
scripts.data:sample: node pipeline/extract.ts --input pipeline/fixtures/sample.jsonl.gz --out data/work-sample && node pipeline/select.ts --work data/work-sample --taxonomies pipeline/fixtures/taxonomies --source fixture --target 300
